entries.title: Matthew 16:1
segments: The Pharisees and the Sadducees came to Him, tempting Him. And they asked Him that He would show them a sign from Heaven.

entries.title: Matthew 16:2
segments: He answered and said to them, When it is evening, you say, Fair weather; for the sky is red.

entries.title: Matthew 16:3
segments: And in the morning, Foul weather today; for the sky is red and gloomy. Hypocrites! You can discern the face of the sky, but you cannot [see] the signs of the times!

entries.title: Matthew 16:4
segments: A wicked and adulterous generation seeks after a sign. And there shall no sign be given to it, except the sign of the prophet Jonah. And He left them and went away.

entries.title: Matthew 16:5
segments: And when His disciples had come to the other side, they forgot to take loaves.

entries.title: Matthew 16:6
segments: And Jesus said to them, Take heed, and beware the leaven of the Pharisees and of the Sadducees.

entries.title: Matthew 16:7
segments: And they reasoned among themselves, saying, [It is] because we have taken no loaves.

entries.title: Matthew 16:8
segments: And knowing Jesus said to them, Why do you reason among yourselves because you took no loaves, little-faiths?

entries.title: Matthew 16:9
segments: Do you not yet understand, nor remember the five loaves of the five thousand, and how many hand baskets you took up;

entries.title: Matthew 16:10
segments: nor the seven loaves of the four thousand, and how many lunch baskets you took up?

entries.title: Matthew 16:11
segments: How is it that you do not understand that I did not speak to you about loaves, but to beware of the leaven of the Pharisees and of the Sadducees?

entries.title: Matthew 16:12
segments: Then they understood that He did not say to beware of the leaven of bread, but of the doctrine of the Pharisees and Sadducees.

entries.title: Matthew 16:13
segments: And coming into the parts of Caesarea Philippi, Jesus asked His disciples, saying, Who do men say Me to be, the Son of man?

entries.title: Matthew 16:14
segments: And they said, Some [say], John the Baptist; some, Elijah; and others, Jeremiah, or one of the prophets.

entries.title: Matthew 16:15
segments: He said to them, But who do you say I am?

entries.title: Matthew 16:16
segments: And Simon Peter answered and said, You are the Christ, the Son of the living God.

entries.title: Matthew 16:17
segments: Jesus answered and said to him, You are blessed, Simon, son of Jonah, for flesh and blood did not reveal [it] to you, but My Father in Heaven.

entries.title: Matthew 16:18
segments: And I also say to you that you are Peter, and on this rock I will build My church, and [the] gates of hell shall not prevail against it.

entries.title: Matthew 16:19
segments: And I will give the keys of the kingdom of Heaven to you. And whatever you may bind on earth shall occur, having been bound in Heaven, and whatever you may loose on earth shall occur, having been loosed in Heaven.

entries.title: Matthew 16:20
segments: Then He warned His disciples that they should tell no one that He was Jesus the Christ.

entries.title: Matthew 16:21
segments: From that time Jesus began to show His disciples that He must go to Jerusalem and suffer many things from the elders and chief priests and scribes, and be killed, and be raised again the third day.

entries.title: Matthew 16:22
segments: Then Peter took Him and began to rebuke Him, saying, [God be] gracious to You, Lord! This shall never be to You.

entries.title: Matthew 16:23
segments: But He turned and said to Peter, Go, Satan! You are an offense to Me, for you do not savor the things that are of God, but those that are of men.

entries.title: Matthew 16:24
segments: Then Jesus said to His disciples, If anyone desires to come after Me, let him deny himself and take up his cross and follow Me.

entries.title: Matthew 16:25
segments: For whoever desires to save his life shall lose it, and whoever desires to lose his life for My sake shall find it.

entries.title: Matthew 16:26
segments: For what is a man profited if he shall gain the whole world and lose his own soul? Or what shall a man give in exchange for his soul?

entries.title: Matthew 16:27
segments: For the Son of man shall come in the glory of His Father with His angels, and then He shall reward each one according to his works.

entries.title: Matthew 16:28
segments: Truly I say to you, There are some standing here who shall not taste of death until they see the Son of man coming in His kingdom.
